rootCause: Category discovery matched degree-only queries (e.g. B.TECH Computer Science, M.TECH Environmental Engineering) to the 5,337 'Technical/Polytechnic' AISHE rows purely on the shared 'Technical' token; getSingleCandidate could then report basis 'institutionType-category' for a diploma-level institution in a degree-only context; empty degree-only searches were mislabelled rather than reported as not-found.
corrections: Degree-only category discovery excludes diploma-level institutions (exclusion when no degree name contains /diploma/i).
Empty degree-only results report basis 'none' + CATEGORY_EMPTY_DISCLAIMER (was 'institutionType-category').
getSingleCandidate() never assigns 'institutionType-category' to diploma-level institutions in degree-only contexts.
Program model already carries level/studyMode/duration/source/verificationStatus (reused, no new taxonomy).
